name: player-male.run.png
prompt:
Pixel art game sprite animation, one horizontal strip of EIGHT DISTINCT sequential full-body poses, left-to-right order; NO second row. Final delivery:1536x192, eight192x192 cells, character height about168, ground anchor (96,184) per cell. Match attached ORIGINAL IDLE identity EXACTLY, including costume colors, accessories, slender head/body ratio and 1px colored dark outline. Render a high-detail source with generous vertical magenta space if needed; maintain EIGHT equal horizontal cells and one common foot baseline. PURE flat #FF00FF background, binary silhouette (no antialias/no soft shadows), at most64colors ideally48, warm light from upper-left. HD2D Octopath-like slightly overhead RPG view; no text, numbers, grid, floor, cast shadow, motion blur, trails. No resizing/warping/recoloring clones: eight individually drawn articulated poses. Stable skull size, torso length and pelvis height, only subtle natural2px walk bob at delivery scale. Full hair/boots/accessories never cropped. Loop phase:1 LEFT/near foot forward heel CONTACT, opposite foot back toe-off;2 DOWN left knee bends loading body, right heel lifts;3 PASS right knee advancing past supporting left leg;4 UP right leg swings forward, left heel starts rise;5 RIGHT/far foot forward heel CONTACT, opposite leg back toe-off;6 DOWN right knee bends loading, left heel lifts;7 PASS left knee advances beyond support right leg;8 UP left leg swings forward preparing frame1. Contacts1 and5 show OPPOSITE legs forward; supporting planted foot moves backward against locomotion to prevent sliding. Arms swing opposite legs with clear elbow articulation; cloth and hair lag by one phase. Frame8 connects naturally to frame1, never repeat frame1 as frame8.
WALKING to the RIGHT, 3/4 side view. Near/far legs visibly trade places; opposite-side far boot darker.
Identity is reference image1; preserve all distinctive design from original, NO new equipment. Image2 is the approved peer style only; image3/4 are pixel-outline/shading anchors only.
